note: No fact: the article never says the hospital information systems hold the clinical record or report patients treated, so they are unclassified under the typology. What it does state, should the parent class them emr from another document: parliament approved on 12 February 2026 (94-2-3) amendment 2 to the 2019 AFD loan of EUR 27.3 million for E-Santé, covering modernising and securing health establishments' information systems and deploying them in 24 university hospitals; about 16% drawn (EUR 4.3 million), EUR 23 million remaining, drawdown deadline moved from 30 June 2024 to 30 September 2028 and completion to 31 December 2029; the Ministry of Health supervises.
